methodology.reference: Actual filled GND polygons plus native GND lands/tracks/via annuli, with round and oblong drill holes subtracted. Preferred reference is In1 for F and In2 for B. Both-inner coverage is an alternative projection, not an EM equivalence.
methodology.antipads: Own signal via radius +0.25mm clearance +0.01mm explicit polygon margin excluded, matching the retained USB audit convention.
methodology.path: Centreline graph is noded per actual layer; only real through vias and real copper lands join layers/endpoints. Virtual pad spreading has zero length. No impedance or measured propagation claim.
methodology.detour: Six or more degree-two endpoint segments and >0.25mm extra length over a free-space chord. No clearance-safe straightening or intentional length matching is inferred.
methodology.power: Track-only shortest-path resistance scenario: rho20C=1.7241e-5 ohm*mm,35um copper. Actual copper thickness,temperature,contact/via/component resistance,return paths,current distribution and heating are unqualified.
